findings.current: his hand snatched the curved saber.
findings.defect: This says Temur seized the saber itself, while the source says his hand shot toward it; the following sentence establishes that he never managed to draw it.
findings.rationale: 잡아채 갔다 describes the abrupt movement of his hand toward the weapon, not a completed snatching action.
findings.replacement: his hand shot toward the curved saber.

findings.current: with only fifty subordinates, he had dominated the steppe.
findings.defect: This replaces the source's physical image of riding or ranging across the steppe with the broader claim that he dominated it.
findings.rationale: 초원을 질타했다 depicts forcefully riding across the steppe; the accepted baseline preserved that specific mounted action.
findings.replacement: with only fifty subordinates, he had ridden across the steppe.

summary: Two minor source-fidelity defects remain in the assembled chapter.
